description:
Space Janitor 1.0
Download

What is this?
Space Janitor implements two cleanup functions (fixing/working around vanilla bugs) from Nexerelin in a small standalone mod, to improve performance in the mid/late game:

Scavenger fleets stuck trying to return to their home planet are automatically cleaned up when the player docks at a planet or station
Debris fields expire properly

You don't need to use this if you're already running Nexerelin or DynaSector.

aiDescription: Automatically cleans up scavenger fleets stuck trying to return home when the player docks. Ensures debris fields expire properly. These fixes are already included in Nexerelin or DynaSector.
